vuln.name: Overly Permissive crossdomain.xml Policy
vuln.description: A crossdomain.xml policy file is served that grants Flash/ Silverlight plug-ins from arbitrary domains (allow-access-from domain="*") the ability to read data from this origin, bypassing the same-origin policy.
vuln.impact: Although Flash is largely deprecated, an overly broad crossdomain.xml remains a legacy information-disclosure vector and signals poor security hygiene.
vuln.recommendation: Remove crossdomain.xml if Flash/Silverlight clients are not required. Otherwise restrict allow-access-from to specific trusted domains.
